headline: Phillies idle after sweep, open series at Baltimore tonight
recap: The Phillies have not played since being swept by the Marlins in Miami, dropping the finale 8-6 on Wednesday after leading 6-3 through five innings. Miami tied it with a three-run seventh - Xavier Edwards' two-run single the biggest blow off reliever Seth Johnson, who was charged with the blown save - then went ahead for good on Griffin Conine's pinch-hit, two-run homer off Jonathan Bowlan (2-1, the loss) in the eighth. Pete Fairbanks closed it out for his 15th save. Trea Turner (2-for-5, a home run and an RBI) and Bryson Stott (a two-run double) led Philadelphia's offense. The team was off Thursday.

At 57-52, the Phillies are second in the NL East, seven games behind the first-place Braves and riding a three-game losing streak. The Marlins (55-55) and Nationals (55-55) are tied for third, 9.5 games back.

Philadelphia opens a three-game series at Baltimore tonight, first pitch 7:05 PM ET. Right-hander Brandon Young starts for the Orioles; the Phillies had not announced a starter as of this morning. Baltimore is a slight favorite at -115 on the moneyline, with Philadelphia at -105.
